result.final: Yes. To work in the UK in healthcare for longer than 6 months, an American citizen generally needs a work visa. For eligible healthcare roles, the Health and Care Worker visa requires a qualifying job, an approved UK employer, a certificate of sponsorship and the required salary. A Standard Visitor stay is usually limited to 6 months and does not allow ordinary paid or unpaid work for a UK company. Check the specific role and requirements on [GOV.UK’s Health and Care Worker visa page](https://www.gov.uk/health-care-worker-visa).
